m_title: Latihan {muscle}: cara melakukan, set dan rep
_notes: 'Cara melakukan X' and 'Otot yang dilatih' are the headings Indonesian fitness/health sites use (Halodoc, Hello Sehat, detik, IDN Times, Red Bull ID push-up guides); muscle pages 'Latihan Dada' etc. follow their 'latihan otot dada' articles. 'Gerakan' for exercise and casual 'kamu/-mu' + 'bareng' as on the Indonesian site; 'set', 'rep', 'bodyweight', 'level' kept in English as Indonesian gyms say them. No plural after numbers, so '{n} gerakan' is always correct.
